```yaml
name: Close Stale PRs
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  close-stale-prs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Close stale PRs
        run: |
          # Get all open PRs
          gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls?state=open --paginate \
            | jq -r '.[] | select(.created_at < (now - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60) | tostring) | .number' \
            | while read pr_number; do
              # Check if PR is authored by jdx
              author=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/$pr_number --jq '.user.login')
              if [ "$author" = "jdx" ]; then
                echo "Skipping PR #$pr_number (authored by jdx)"
                continue
              fi

              # Check if PR has keep-open label
              labels=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/$pr_number/labels --jq '.[].name')
              if echo "$labels" | grep -q "keep-open"; then
                echo "Skipping PR #$pr_number (has keep-open label)"
                continue
              fi

              # Close the PR with a comment
              gh pr close $pr_number -c "This PR has been automatically closed due to inactivity. It will be reopened if activity resumes. To keep this PR open, add the 'keep-open' label."
              echo "Closed PR #$pr_number"
            done
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
